reviews.text: Great place to train your dog!
The building is great. Although too far for me it would be a great location to train.
Took nose work classes here many years ago and am back again with a new dog and new lessons. Loved this place for years.
We come here for the STAR alumni gatherings and always have the greatest time. Mary has done a wonderful job with this place, and we absolutely love her.
Great agility field. Owner is very easy to work with for rentals.
